plain: Well-known figures in the government UFO world are said to keep telling Senate staff that they know people with inside knowledge who are too afraid to come forward. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell says this, naming those who pass it on: the physicist Hal Puthoff, the physicist Eric Davis, the former intelligence officer David Grusch, the former Pentagon official Luis Elizondo and the former Pentagon official Christopher Mellon, who "all tell us that they know people." If true, it would mean more witnesses exist than have yet spoken.
